“But she’s just a corgi…”  Meet Maple the 4 year old Corgi.  Sweet in the right moments… but dangerous in the wrong ones. Resource guarding food and household items. Multiple bites on owners and family members. Reactive to other dogs on walks, barking & lunging. And now there’s a baby in the home. During the evaluation, Maple tried to bite me multiple times. Not because she’s a “bad dog”… But because she’s been making decisions for a long time without clear direction. No real structure. No consistent boundaries. No clear communication or expectations. And when you let “dogs be dogs” they do just that.  This is the part people struggle with.. You can love your dog deeply and still be missing the leadership they actually need. Honest question… Do you think dogs like Maple know they’re doing something wrong… or are they just doing what’s always worked for them? #DogTraining #dogtrainer #dogsoftiktok #dogs #dog

This is my mom’s morning skincare routine at 67 years old (1 of 2). Not sponsored, just her  routine explained in more detail. And it’s GONE!!! They were so amazing, we did numb the hand off camera but they were super comforting around my anxiety. I remember one of the comments from you guys on my past videos saying to advocate for myself and let the doctors know about my anxiety and to ask for any accommodations.  The doctor was so great , she gave me a little stress ball in the shape of a heart 🥹❤️ and she got some cold spray to put on my hand (which did help a little) and the assistant tapped my leg to distract me as well. For the shots I kept thinking to myself that - if I have gotten shots in my mouth before (a very sensitive space mind you) at the dentist, I could definitely do my hand. I was trying to give my brain evidence that we have done some similar before and that it turned out okay. And anytime it hurt, I just sang a little extra louder 😣 they were so supportive.  This was a huge step from a few weeks ago, when I went to the doctor and had a panic attack in their office when they said they wanted to draw my blood. I’m still very afraid of that, but I’m taking little steps at a time! Especially if I want to start a family and go through pregnancy, I want to get more comfortable with needles. #procrastination #needles #dermatalogy #mole #cyst
